## What changed / 改了什么
Describe the case, documentation, or presentation change and why it helps readers.

## Sources and rights / 出处与许可
For case changes (use “not applicable” for layout-only changes):
- Original author and source URL:
- Model evidence and pipeline (author claim vs independently checked):
- Prompt status: original / short or partial / unpublished (never relabel a reconstruction):
- Media and reference-image rights or license-unknown note:

## Validation / 验证
- [ ] Ran `python3 tools/verify.py` on the final staged generated output
- [ ] English and Chinese README/catalog counts stay synchronized
- [ ] New cases include all documented media attachments, `prompt.md`, and source notes
- [ ] Pending / promo / 2.5 / multimodel / failure cases stay out of main buckets
- [ ] Source claims are not presented as independent model verification
- [ ] Added a preview for visual changes, when applicable
